items.title: 永和豆漿創始人林炳生去世 享壽70歲！
items.title_en: Founder of Yonghe Soy Milk, Lin Bing-sheng, Passes Away at Age 70
paras: 永和資本集團董事局 8 日（周六）發布訃告，宣布董事局主席、永和豆漿創始人林炳生，因病醫治無效，不幸於 7 日中午 12 時 45 分在台北安詳逝世，享壽 70 歲。
林炳生是永和資本集團奠基創始人，創立永和豆漿，深耕實業數十載，帶領集團布局大健康產業、股權投資、產業併購，開拓海外 SPAC 上市業務，搭建起多元化規範化的產業體系。
業界和外界素以「豆哥」尊稱，評價其「活出自己的精彩，是照亮別人的燈塔」。
永和資本集團董事局表示，為妥善處置後續事宜，經決定：治喪期間，集團總部及各下屬機構全面簡化商務活動，全員肅穆致哀。追悼儀式具體安排，後續另行通告。
集團各項經營工作由董事局統籌銜接，平穩過渡，全體員工堅守崗位，恪盡職守，確保集團業務穩定有序發展，接續傳承先生畢生事業與治企初心。
paras_en: Yonghe Capital Group's board announced on Saturday the 8th that its chairman and Yonghe Soy Milk founder Lin Bing-sheng, after unsuccessful treatment for an illness, peacefully died at 12:45 p.m. on the 7th in Taipei, aged 70.

Lin Bing-sheng, the founding pillar of Yonghe Capital Group, established Yonghe Soy Milk and devoted decades to industry, steering the group into the health sector, equity investments, corporate mergers and acquisitions, and expanding overseas SPAC listings, building a diversified and standardized industrial ecosystem.
He was affectionately known in the industry and beyond as “Soybean Brother,” praised for “living his own brilliance and serving as a lighthouse that illuminates others.”

The board stated that to properly handle subsequent matters, it has decided that during the mourning period the group’s headquarters and all subsidiaries will fully simplify business activities and observe solemn mourning; details of the memorial service will be announced later.

All operational matters of the group will be coordinated by the board to ensure a smooth transition, with staff remaining at their posts, fulfilling their duties, and guaranteeing stable, orderly development of the business while continuing to uphold the founder’s lifelong mission and corporate philosophy.

items.title: 志聖H1獲利創新高EPS達 7.16元  7月營收以11.68億元再登頂
items.title_en: Zhi Sheng H1 Profit Hits Record High, EPS Reaches NT$7.16; July Revenue Tops NT$1.168 billion
paras: PCB 及半導體廠志聖工業 (2467-TW) 今 (8) 日公布 2026 年最新營收資訊，2026 年 7 月營收以 11.68 億元再登頂，也是繼 5 月營收以 10.22 億元突破單月營收 10 億元大關後的另一重大突破。同時，志聖上半年稅後純益 11.06 億元，年增 2.09 倍，每股純益 7.16 元。
志聖 2026 年第二季營收 27.83 億元，自結單季稅後純益 6.4 億元，季增 37.33%，單季每股純益 4.1 元。志聖 2026 上半年自結營收 50.44 億元，較去年同期成長 78.92%；歸屬母公司業主稅後純益 11.06 億元，年增 2.09 倍，每股純益 7.16 元
屬台積電 (2330-TW) 供應鏈的志聖表示，2026 年營運主要受惠於先進封裝與先進 PCB 兩大成長動能。隨 AI 及高效能運算需求持續擴大，Foundry 與 OSAT 客戶持續增加先進封裝資本支出，帶動相關設備需求成長；先進 PCB 方面，IC 載板與 HLC 高階多層板業者亦大幅擴增資本支出，推升設備接單及出貨動能。
在 2026 年第一季，志聖來自半導體產業營收占比已達 50%，顯示公司轉型布局持續深化。單看第二季，營收 27.83 億元，季增 23.04%；稅後純益 6.4 億元，季增 37.33%，年增 2.09 倍。展望後市，志聖看好 AI 基礎建設帶動先進封裝與先進 PCB 投資需求，對後續成長維持樂觀看法。
paras_en: PCB and semiconductor manufacturer Zhi Sheng Industrial (2467‑TW) announced on July 8 its latest 2026 revenue figures. July 2026 revenue reached NT$1.168 billion, marking another peak after May’s NT$1.022 billion, which broke the NT$1 billion monthly threshold. For the first half of the year, net profit after tax was NT$1.106 billion, up 2.09‑fold year‑over‑year, translating to earnings per share of NT$7.16.

Zhi Sheng’s July 2026 revenue of NT$1.168 billion grew 34.33% month‑over‑month and 1.32‑times year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑July was NT$6.212 billion, already surpassing the full‑year 2025 revenue of NT$6.102 billion, an increase of 87.05% year‑over‑year.

In Q2 2026, Zhi Sheng posted revenue of NT$2.783 billion and a quarterly net profit after tax of NT$640 million, up 37.33% quarter‑over‑quarter, with quarterly EPS of NT$4.10. For the first half of 2026, revenue reached NT$5.044 billion, a 78.92% increase from the same period last year, and net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$1.106 billion, up 2.09‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding EPS of NT$7.16.

Zhi Sheng, a supplier in TSMC’s (2330‑TW) ecosystem, said its 2026 operations were mainly driven by two growth engines: advanced packaging and advanced PCBs. As AI and high‑performance computing demand expands, foundry and OSAT customers are increasing capital expenditures on advanced packaging, boosting equipment demand; in the advanced PCB segment, IC substrate and high‑layer‑count (HLC) high‑end multilayer board makers are also significantly raising capex, fueling equipment orders and shipments.

In Q1 2026, revenue from the semiconductor sector accounted for 50% of Zhi Sheng’s total, indicating deepening of its transformation strategy. In Q2, revenue of NT$2.783 billion rose 23.04% quarter‑over‑quarter, and net profit after tax of NT$640 million grew 37.33% quarter‑over‑quarter, a 2.09‑fold year‑over‑year increase. Looking ahead, Zhi Sheng is optimistic that AI infrastructure will continue to drive investment demand for advanced packaging and advanced PCBs, maintaining a positive outlook for future growth.

items.title: 美國、中國AI投資收益有限！台灣、南韓、日本成最大贏家？
items.title_en: Limited Returns from US and China AI Investments! Taiwan, South Korea, and Japan as the Biggest Winners?
paras: 中美兩國近年競相投入天文數字的人工智慧（AI）建設資金，這股熱潮如今已具體反映在各地的經濟數據上，但受惠程度卻呈現明顯落差。美國雖是投資規模最大的國家, 實際拉抬經濟成長的效果卻相對有限；反倒是南韓、台灣、日本等半導體出口重鎮，短期內享受到遠超預期的成長紅利。
根據史丹佛大學「以人為本人工智慧研究院」（HAI）統計，2013 年至 2025 年間，美國民間累計投資 AI 相關領域達 7572 億美元，穩居全球之冠，其中光是 2025 年一年就砸下 2858 億美元，占比逼近四成。
中國則以 1318 億美元緊追在後，規模不到美國的兩成，不過若計入官方基金投入，實際金額恐怕不止於此。
儘管資金瘋狂湧入，美國經濟成長受惠的幅度卻不如表面數字亮眼。摩根士丹利估算，數據中心等 AI 相關支出原本可將美國 GDP 成長率推升 1.37 個百分點，但由於美國建設數據中心所需的先進晶片與通訊設備高度仰賴進口，一旦扣除進口增加對成長率造成的負面拖累，AI 投資對美國經濟的實質貢獻，恐怕僅剩 0.16 個百分點。
值得留意的是，隨著數據中心建設案接連上馬，尖端晶片與伺服器供不應求，價格節節攀升，連帶讓搭載相關晶片的產品與服務也承受漲價壓力。
美國聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）曾多次強調，AI 普及長期而言有助於提升生產力並壓低物價，但就眼前情勢來看，需求擴張帶來的漲價效應顯然更為明顯。
聯準會理事沃勒（Christopher Waller）甚至警告，若 AI 投資持續狂飆，恐怕反倒會成為推升通膨的新變數。
相較之下，中國的情況又是另一番景象。當地將 AI 與高科技技術導入工廠及物流體系，帶動工業生產與出口競爭力雙雙提升。
國際金融協會（IIF）分析指出，數據中心建設、通訊設備生產等數位產業，如今已占中國 GDP 逾一成，近年更平均為整體經濟成長貢獻了將近 1 個百分點的動能。
不過，這股力道仍不足以填補房地產市場低迷所留下的內需缺口，「AI 提升生產力、進而帶動薪資成長」的良性循環，在中國也尚未真正成形。
與美國類似，中國在 AI 投資所需的高階晶片上同樣長期依賴進口，半導體貿易收支持續處於逆差狀態。
值得注意的是，真正嚐到甜頭的，反而是在半導體出口上具備優勢的南韓、台灣等經濟體。
國際貨幣基金（IMF）最新一期《世界經濟展望》顯示，南韓、台灣、泰國、馬來西亞今年第一季的 GDP 年化季增率，平均較 IMF 原先預測高出 4.4 個百分點。
其中南韓表現最為突出，季增年化率達 7.5%，足足是 IMF 預測值的四倍；台灣今年上半年出口額則較去年同期大增 47%，其中約八成來自伺服器、半導體等資訊科技設備，顯示 AI 需求的強勁拉動效應。
日本也可望在半導體製造設備與電子零組件出口上跟著沾光。野村證券經濟學家伊藤勇輝估算，若亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 等美國科技巨頭依原訂計畫推進 2026 年的 AI 投資，日本相關出口有機會因此成長 17%。
外界普遍期待，這波 AI 熱潮能重現 1990 年代美國「無通膨式經濟成長」的榮景，長遠來看確實存在強勁拉抬美國經濟的可能性。
不過，市場同時也擔憂，AI 對企業獲利與生產力的實際改善程度，恐怕不如預期樂觀。
事實上，先前過熱的 AI 相關投機資金自 7 月起已出現逆轉跡象，全球股市中的 AI 與半導體概念股跌勢加劇，「AI 投資是否過熱」的疑慮正逐漸浮上檯面。
IMF 也提出警示，一旦市場對 AI 前景的預期降溫，除了美國、中國等投資主力國家之外，南韓等身為半導體供應鏈要角的經濟體，同樣可能面臨股市進入修正、股價下跌抑制消費動能的風險。
paras_en: In recent years the United States and China have poured astronomical sums into AI development, a wave now reflected in economic data worldwide, but the benefits have been uneven. While the US invests the most, its impact on economic growth is relatively modest; by contrast semiconductor-export powerhouses such as South Korea, Taiwan and Japan are enjoying short‑term growth dividends far beyond expectations.

According to Stanford University's Institute for Human‑Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI), private AI investment in the United States totaled $757.2 billion from 2013 to 2025, the highest in the world, with $285.8 billion poured in just in 2025—almost 40% of the cumulative total.
China follows with $131.8 billion, less than 20% of the US figure, though official fund contributions likely push the true amount higher.

Despite the flood of capital, the boost to US economic growth is less striking than the headline numbers suggest. Morgan Stanley estimates that AI‑related spending such as data‑center construction could lift US GDP growth by 1.37 percentage points, but because the advanced chips and communications gear needed are heavily imported, the net contribution after accounting for the drag from imports falls to only about 0.16 percentage points.

It is worth noting that as data‑center projects roll out, demand for cutting‑edge chips and servers outstrips supply, driving up prices and passing cost pressures onto products and services that rely on those components.

Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has repeatedly stressed that AI diffusion will ultimately raise productivity and lower prices, but given current conditions the inflationary impact of expanding demand is far more evident.
Fed Governor Christopher Waller even warned that if AI investment continues to surge, it could become a new source of inflationary pressure.
China’s situation, by contrast, looks different. The country is integrating AI and high‑tech tools into factories and logistics, boosting both industrial output and export competitiveness.

The International Institute of Finance (IIF) notes that digital industries such as data‑center construction and communications equipment now account for more than 10% of China’s GDP and have contributed roughly 1 percentage point of growth momentum in recent years.

However, that force is still insufficient to fill the domestic‑demand gap left by a sluggish real‑estate market; the virtuous cycle of “AI raising productivity, which in turn lifts wages” has not yet materialised in China.
Like the United States, China also relies heavily on imported high‑end chips for AI investment, keeping its semiconductor trade balance in a persistent deficit.
The real beneficiaries are economies with semiconductor export advantages, such as South Korea and Taiwan.

The latest IMF World Economic Outlook shows that South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand and Malaysia all posted first‑quarter 2024 GDP annualised growth rates that averaged 4.4 percentage points above the IMF’s own forecasts.

South Korea stood out with an annualised quarterly growth rate of 7.5%, four times the IMF’s estimate; Taiwan’s exports in the first half of the year jumped 47% year‑on‑year, about 80% of which came from servers, semiconductors and other IT equipment, underscoring the strong pull of AI demand.

Japan is also poised to benefit from semiconductor‑manufacturing equipment and electronic component exports. Nomura economist Yuuki Ito estimates that if US tech giants such as Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) proceed with their planned 2026 AI investments, Japan’s related exports could grow by as much as 17%.
Many expect this AI boom to recreate the 1990s US “growth without inflation” era, and in the long run it could indeed provide a powerful lift to the US economy.
Nevertheless, markets also worry that AI’s actual impact on corporate profits and productivity may fall short of optimistic expectations.

In fact, speculative AI‑related capital that had overheated began to reverse in July, with AI and semiconductor stocks falling faster in global markets, bringing the question of whether AI investment is over‑heated to the fore.

The IMF also warned that if market expectations for AI cool, not only the major investor nations like the US and China but also semiconductor‑chain economies such as South Korea could see stock‑market corrections and falling share prices that dampen consumer momentum.

items.title: AI光通訊需求爆發！祥茂光電財報報喜：800G營收暴增逾10倍、1.6T蓄勢放量
items.title_en: Applied Optoelectronics' Earnings Report Exceeds Expectations, Driven by Strong Demand for High-Speed Optical Communication Products
paras: 人工智慧（AI）資料中心持續擴大建置，帶動高速光通訊需求升溫，美國光模組廠商祥茂光電科技 (AAOI-US) 最新財報優於預期，成為週五（7 日）點燃整體光通訊族群行情的催化劑。市場解讀，祥茂光電強勁的資料中心業務表現，顯示 AI 算力基礎建設對高速光互聯產品的需求仍相當旺盛。
祥茂光電第 2 季營收達 1.919 億美元，年增 86%，其中資料中心業務營收首度突破 1 億美元；排除特殊項目後，每股盈餘（EPS）為 0.06 美元，不僅優於市場預期，也高於公司原先財測區間上緣。
展望第 3 季，祥茂光電預估營收將達 2.55 億至 2.90 億美元，並維持全年營收約 11 億美元的目標。
財報公布後，市場資金迅速湧入光通訊類股，Coherent(COHR-US) 股價單日大漲約 13%，Lumentum(LITE-US) 與康寧也分別上揚約 6% 及 5%，祥茂光電自身股價則走高約 9%。
分析師認為，祥茂光電財報不只是單一公司的利多，更可能替整個光通訊產業釋放正面訊號。由於 AI 資料中心持續擴張，伺服器、GPU 與交換器之間需要更高速率的資料傳輸，光學收發器因此成為 AI 基礎建設不可或缺的關鍵零組件。
Coherent、祥茂光電、Lumentum 與康寧 (GLW-US) 均深度布局相關市場，因此被市場視為 AI 基礎建設的「賣鏟人」概念股。
其中，Coherent 與 Lumentum 即將在下週公布最新財報，市場正密切觀察兩家公司能否複製祥茂光電的強勁表現。分析師預期，在 AI 資料中心需求持續強勁的情況下，兩家公司營收與獲利仍有望維持成長。
值得注意的是，Coherent 與 Lumentum 均與輝達 (NVDA-US) 存在資本或業務層面的連結，進一步提高市場對其 AI 光互聯布局的關注度。

400G 光模組仍是主力　800G 營收暴增逾 10 倍

從祥茂光電產品結構來看，資料中心業務的高速產品需求正在快速轉向更高傳輸速率。
第 2 季 400G 光模組營收達 4840 萬美元，年增超過 4 倍，目前仍是資料中心業務的重要收入來源。不過，相較之下，800G 產品的成長速度更加驚人。
祥茂光電第 2 季 800G 營收達 1280 萬美元，較去年同期大增逾 10 倍，較第 1 季更成長超過 1 倍。公司更預期，第 3 季 800G 營收將較第 2 季接近成長 5 倍。
這代表祥茂光電的資料中心產品組合正在快速升級，成長主軸將逐步從 100G、400G 等既有產品，轉向 800G 甚至 1.6T 等更高速率的光模組。

需求高於供給 20% 至 40%　產能成 AI 光模組最大瓶頸

祥茂光電管理層在財報電話會議中透露，目前客戶需求已經比公司的供應能力高出約 20% 至 40%，顯示市場需求並非當前限制營收成長的主要因素，真正的瓶頸反而落在產能擴張、關鍵零組件供應，以及新一代 1.6T 產品的客戶認證進度。
根據公司財務長 Stefan Murry，祥茂光電目前 800G 與 1.6T 產品的月產能接近 20 萬片，較第 1 季末約 10 萬片明顯增加。
祥茂光電預計，到 2026 年底月產能將超過 65 萬片，2027 年底進一步提升至超過 93 萬片，其中逾半產能將來自德州廠。
除了 800G 之外，1.6T 被視為祥茂光電下一個重要成長引擎。
公司管理層表示，祥茂光電即將成為某一家大型超大規模資料中心業者第 4 家通過 1.6T 產品認證的供應商，預計在未來 2 至 3 週內完成認證，並於第 3 季末開始出貨、第 4 季進一步放量。
祥茂光電執行長林誌祥預期，第 4 季 1.6T 光收發器營收將超過 7000 萬美元，並認為明年第 1 季仍有大幅成長空間，甚至不排除營收季增一倍。
從更長期來看，公司預估至 2027 年中，100G 與 400G 產品月營收約 9000 萬美元，800G 月營收約 2.17 億美元，1.6T 則可達約 1.64 億美元，資料中心光收發器合計月營收有望達到約 4.71 億美元。
不過，這項成長藍圖仍存在供應鏈與生產端風險，取決於設備安裝、客戶認證、材料供應和製造良率等多個條件協同推進。
祥茂光電坦承，1.6T 關鍵零件 DSP、TIA 供應仍較緊張，第四季度 1.6T 交付的主要約束來自材料而非產能本身。
paras_en: The continuous expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) data centers has driven up demand for high-speed optical communication, and US-based optical module manufacturer Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) has released a better-than-expected earnings report, becoming a catalyst for the overall optical communication sector on Friday.

Applied Optoelectronics' second-quarter revenue reached $191.9 million, up 86% year-over-year, with data center business revenue exceeding $100 million for the first time; excluding special items, earnings per share (EPS) were $0.06, exceeding market expectations and the company's original forecast range.
Looking ahead to the third quarter, Applied Optoelectronics expects revenue to reach $255 million to $290 million and maintains its full-year revenue target of around $1.1 billion.

After the earnings report was released, market funds quickly flowed into optical communication stocks, with Coherent (COHR-US) stock price surging around 13%, Lumentum (LITE-US) and Corning rising around 6% and 5%, respectively, and Applied Optoelectronics' stock price rising around 9%.

Analysts believe that Applied Optoelectronics' earnings report is not only a positive factor for the company but also a positive signal for the entire optical communication industry, as AI data centers continue to expand, requiring higher-speed data transmission between servers, GPUs, and switches, making optical transceivers a crucial component.
Coherent, Applied Optoelectronics, Lumentum, and Corning (GLW-US) are all deeply invested in related markets and are seen by the market as 'pick-and-shovel' concept stocks for AI infrastructure.

Coherent and Lumentum are scheduled to release their latest earnings reports next week, and the market is closely watching to see if they can replicate Applied Optoelectronics' strong performance; analysts expect that if AI data center demand remains strong, the two companies' revenue and profits will continue to grow.
Notably, Coherent and Lumentum have capital or business ties with NVIDIA (NVDA-US), further increasing market attention to their AI optical interconnect layout.

400G optical modules remain the mainstay, while 800G revenue surges over 10 times; from Applied Optoelectronics' product structure, high-speed product demand in data center businesses is rapidly shifting towards higher transmission rates.

In the second quarter, 400G optical module revenue reached $48.4 million, up more than four times year-over-year, and remains an important source of revenue for data center businesses; however, 800G product growth is even more impressive.

Applied Optoelectronics' second-quarter 800G revenue reached $12.8 million, up over 10 times year-over-year and more than double the first quarter; the company expects third-quarter 800G revenue to grow nearly five times from the second quarter.
This represents a rapid upgrade of Applied Optoelectronics' data center product portfolio, with growth shifting from existing 100G and 400G products to higher-speed 800G and 1.6T optical modules.

Demand exceeds supply by 20% to 40%; production capacity is the biggest bottleneck for AI optical modules; Applied Optoelectronics' management revealed in the earnings conference call that customer demand has exceeded the company's supply capacity by around 20% to 40%, indicating that market demand is not the main factor limiting revenue growth, and the real bottleneck lies in production capacity expansion, key component supply, and customer certification for new 1.6T products.

According to the company's CFO, Stefan Murry, Applied Optoelectronics' current monthly production capacity for 800G and 1.6T products is close to 200,000 units, significantly increased from around 100,000 units at the end of the first quarter.

Applied Optoelectronics expects its monthly production capacity to exceed 650,000 units by the end of 2026 and over 930,000 units by the end of 2027, with more than half of the production capacity coming from its Texas factory.

In addition to 800G, 1.6T is seen as Applied Optoelectronics' next major growth engine; the company's management stated that Applied Optoelectronics is about to become the fourth supplier to pass 1.6T product certification for a large hyperscale data center operator, expecting to complete certification within the next 2-3 weeks and start shipping in the third quarter, with further expansion in the fourth quarter.

Applied Optoelectronics' CEO, Dr. Thompson Lin, expects 1.6T optical transceiver revenue to exceed $70 million in the fourth quarter and believes there is still significant growth potential in the first quarter of next year, not ruling out the possibility of revenue increasing by more than 100% quarter-over-quarter.

From a longer-term perspective, the company estimates that by mid-2027, 100G and 400G product monthly revenue will be around $90 million, 800G monthly revenue will be around $217 million, and 1.6T will reach around $164 million, with total data center optical transceiver monthly revenue expected to reach around $471 million.

However, this growth blueprint still carries supply chain and production risks, depending on the coordination of multiple conditions such as equipment installation, customer certification, material supply, and manufacturing yield.

Applied Optoelectronics admits that the supply of key components such as DSP and TIA for 1.6T products is still relatively tight, and the main constraint for 1.6T delivery in the fourth quarter comes from materials rather than production capacity itself.
The company is working to address these challenges and ensure a smooth ramp-up of its 1.6T products to meet growing customer demand.

items.title: 基金爆倉反成加分題？「AI股神」遭重創  矽谷投資人反而搶著押注
items.title_en: Fund’s Margin Call Turns Into a Plus? ‘AI Stock God’ Smashed, Yet Silicon Valley Investors Rush to Bet
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資圈近期爆發的槓桿危機，非但沒有澆熄矽谷對新世代 AI 投資人的熱情，反而出現意外的「逆勢追捧」。
前 OpenAI 研究員 Leopold Aschenbrenner 旗下避險基金 Situational Awareness 近期因高槓桿與集中持股遭遇流動性危機，甚至被迫大幅減碼股票部位。
不過，根據《彭博》報導，基金爆發危機後短短幾天內，多名矽谷投資人反而主動接觸該基金，表達追加資金的興趣。
知情人士透露，Situational Awareness 目前暫未接受新資金，但投資圈對 Aschenbrenner 的信心並未因此明顯動搖。
紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）合夥人 Pat Grady 甚至公開表示，他認為 Aschenbrenner 仍將是未來很長一段時間內矽谷的重要人物。
分析指出，這起事件也凸顯出矽谷與華爾街對「高風險、高報酬」投資模式截然不同的評價標準：華爾街看到的是槓桿、集中持倉與風險管理失控；矽谷部分投資人看到的，卻是一名押注 AI 長期趨勢的投資人，在遭遇挫敗後重新出發的機會。

槓桿危機引爆強制平倉　基金仍保有逾百億美元資產

Situational Awareness 此次危機的導火線，是融資機構要求追加保證金。
面對流動性壓力，基金緊急出售大部分股票持倉，並將相關部位出售給 Citadel 創辦人 Ken Griffin 旗下的 Citadel，折價幅度超過 10%。
這場拋售也讓市場迅速意識到，Aschenbrenner 原本高度集中的 AI 投資策略，可能因槓桿放大而面臨劇烈的下行風險。
Aschenbrenner 隨後向投資人承認投資策略出現錯誤，並宣布全面解除基金槓桿。他將此次事件形容為一場「代價高昂」的經驗，但同時強調，這些教訓將成為基金未來發展的重要資產。
儘管遭遇猛烈衝擊，Situational Awareness 目前剩餘資產，包括私募投資在內，總價值仍約 100 億美元；更值得注意的是，基金今年迄今仍錄得約 80% 的正報酬。

矽谷反而力挺　「英雄敘事」蓋過爆倉陰影

在傳統金融市場，基金爆倉通常會嚴重打擊經理人的聲譽；但 Aschenbrenner 的情況卻出現不同結果。
風險投資機構 Redpoint Ventures 董事總經理 Logan Bartlett 表示，矽谷存在一種特殊的「英雄原型」，Aschenbrenner 這次遭遇挫敗，反而讓部分支持者產生更強的凝聚力。
知名創投人士 Elad Gil 也公開表示，他已首次申請投資 Aschenbrenner 旗下基金。
紐約大學 Stern 商學院兼任教授、Focus Investment Group 董事總經理 Gygmy Gonnot 則認為，這種截然不同的反應，源自矽谷與華爾街衡量成功的方式不同。
對矽谷而言，只要投資人押中了足以改變產業格局的技術趨勢，即使過程中承擔巨大波動，也可能被視為值得；但對華爾街而言，核心仍是如何控制風險、保住本金，同時取得合理的風險調整後報酬。

華爾街早有疑慮　集中持股與高槓桿成最大警訊

然而，從華爾街角度來看，Situational Awareness 此次遭遇的危機並非完全出乎意料。
S3 Partners 創辦人 Bob Sloan 直指，這檔基金同時具備高度集中、交易擁擠以及高槓桿三項特徵，而這三種風險一旦同時出現，很容易在市場反轉時形成連鎖反應。
事實上，在基金此次危機爆發之前，部分大型金融機構就已對其風險結構有所疑慮。
與許多成熟避險基金不同，Situational Awareness 的主要投資者是舊金山灣區的富裕個人與家族辦公室，而非大型退休基金或主權財富基金。
《彭博》先前報導指出，巴克萊在基金危機爆發前數週，曾以單一產業曝險過度集中為由，拒絕將 Situational Awareness 納入主經紀業務客戶。
據悉，摩根士丹利最初也曾因 Aschenbrenner 投資經驗不足而拒絕提供主經紀服務，但知情人士透露，該銀行後來改變態度，計畫在未來數週內與 Situational Awareness 建立主經紀關係。
另一方面，高盛、摩根大通與美國銀行則曾向該基金提供槓桿資金。

AI 基金成為高報酬競技場　7 月拋售潮放大風險

分析指出，Situational Awareness 所處的 AI 專注型避險基金市場，本身就是一個高報酬與高波動並存的戰場。
部分競爭對手同樣取得驚人績效。例如 Value Aligned Research Advisors 由來自貝萊德（BlackRock）與 Hudson River Trading 等機構的資深人士組成，截至 6 月底管理資產規模超過 260 億美元。
根據《彭博》取得的投資人文件，該公司旗下 AI 基金今年截至 6 月底的報酬率約 194%，同期標普 500 指數漲幅則不到 10%，兩者差距極為懸殊。
但高報酬同樣伴隨高風險。7 月 AI 類股遭遇拋售時，多家大型避險基金也受到衝擊。Millennium Management 當月下跌 2.1%，Point72 Asset Management 下跌 3.3%，而持股更為集中的 Altimeter Capital Management 則重挫 11%。
部分投資人甚至提前預判 Situational Awareness 可能遭遇強制拋售，並預先建立避險部位。

去槓桿只是第一步　Aschenbrenner 下一關仍是華爾街

分析人士認為，對 Aschenbrenner 而言，此次危機真正的考驗可能不是如何重新獲得矽谷投資人的支持，而是如何重新取得華爾街金融機構的信任。
他已宣布清除基金所有槓桿，現階段也不再透過銀行主經紀業務放大投資部位。
然而，問題在於，若希望重現今年早期的超高報酬，單靠自有資金可能限制投資規模與策略彈性。換言之，未來若要再次大舉押注 AI，Aschenbrenner 最終仍可能需要重新取得銀行融資與槓桿支持。
分析稱，這使他陷入一個微妙的局面。一方面，矽谷投資人仍相信他押注 AI 的長期眼光；另一方面，華爾街則會要求他證明自己能夠控制槓桿、降低持倉集中度，並建立更成熟的風險管理制度。
paras_en: The recent leveraged crisis erupting in the AI investment circle has not dampened Silicon Valley’s enthusiasm for the next‑generation AI investors; instead, it has sparked an unexpected “counter‑trend rally.”

Leopold Aschenbrenner, a former OpenAI researcher, runs the hedge fund Situational Awareness, which recently ran into a liquidity crunch because of high leverage and a concentrated stock portfolio, forcing the fund to dramatically cut its equity positions.
According to Bloomberg, within just a few days of the fund’s crisis, several Silicon Valley investors proactively reached out to the fund, expressing interest in adding capital.
Sources familiar with the matter say Situational Awareness has not yet taken new money, but confidence in Aschenbrenner within the investment community has not visibly wavered.
Sequoia Capital partner Pat Grady even publicly stated that he believes Aschenbrenner will remain a key figure in Silicon Valley for a long time to come.

Analysts note that the episode highlights the starkly different standards Silicon Valley and Wall Street apply to “high‑risk, high‑reward” investing: Wall Street sees leverage, concentration and loss of risk control; some Silicon Valley investors see a person betting on the long‑term AI trend who, after a setback, now has a chance to restart.
Leverage crisis triggers forced liquidation – the fund still holds over $10 billion in assets. The spark for Situational Awareness’s latest trouble was a margin call from its financing partners.
Facing liquidity pressure, the fund hurriedly sold most of its equity holdings, offloading the positions to Citadel, the firm founded by Ken Griffin, at a discount of more than 10 %.
The sell‑off quickly made the market aware that Aschenbrenner’s highly concentrated AI strategy could suffer severe downside risk when leverage amplifies losses.

Aschenbrenner later admitted to investors that the investment approach was flawed and announced a full unwind of the fund’s leverage. He described the episode as a “costly” learning experience, but stressed that the lessons will become valuable assets for the fund’s future development.
Despite the shock, Situational Awareness still has roughly $10 billion in assets left, including private‑equity holdings, and it has posted about an 80 % positive return year‑to‑date.

Silicon Valley backs the fund – the “hero narrative” overshadows the margin‑call shadow. In traditional finance, a fund’s collapse usually damages a manager’s reputation, but Aschenbrenner’s case has produced a different outcome.

Redpoint Ventures managing director Logan Bartlett said there is a special “hero archetype” in Silicon Valley, and Aschenbrenner’s setback has actually strengthened cohesion among some of his supporters.
Prominent venture investor Elad Gil also publicly announced that he has filed his first investment request for Aschenbrenner’s fund.
Gygmy Gonnot, a professor at NYU Stern and managing director of Focus Investment Group, believes the divergent reactions stem from the different ways Silicon Valley and Wall Street measure success.

For Silicon Valley, as long as an investor backs a technology trend that could reshape an industry, even massive volatility may be deemed worthwhile; Wall Street, however, remains focused on risk control, capital preservation, and achieving reasonable risk‑adjusted returns.
Wall Street had long harbored doubts – concentration and high leverage were the biggest red flags. From Wall Street’s perspective, the crisis at Situational Awareness was not entirely unexpected.

Bob Sloan, founder of S3 Partners, pointed out that the fund combined three risk factors – high concentration, crowded trading and high leverage – and when they appear together they can trigger a chain reaction in a market reversal.
In fact, before the crisis erupted, several large financial institutions had already raised concerns about the fund’s risk structure.
Unlike many mature hedge funds, Situational Awareness’s primary investors are wealthy individuals and family offices in the San Francisco Bay Area, not large pension funds or sovereign wealth funds.
Bloomberg previously reported that Barclays, weeks before the fund’s crisis, refused to onboard Situational Awareness as a prime brokerage client, citing excessive single‑industry exposure.

It is understood that Morgan Stanley initially declined to provide prime brokerage services because of Aschenbrenner’s limited investment experience, but insiders say the bank later changed its stance and plans to establish a prime brokerage relationship in the coming weeks.
On the other hand, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America have all provided leveraged financing to the fund.

AI funds have become a high‑return arena – July sell‑offs amplified risk. Analysts note that the AI‑focused hedge‑fund market, where Situational Awareness operates, is inherently a battlefield of high returns and high volatility.

Some competitors have also posted eye‑popping performance. For example, Value Aligned Research Advisors, staffed by veterans from BlackRock, Hudson River Trading and other firms, managed over $26 billion in assets as of the end of June.

According to investor documents obtained by Bloomberg, the AI fund run by that firm posted a roughly 194 % return through June, while the S&P 500 rose less than 10 % over the same period – a stark contrast.

But high returns come with high risk. When AI stocks were sold off in July, several large hedge funds felt the impact: Millennium Management fell 2.1 %, Point72 Asset Management dropped 3.3 %, and the more concentrated Altimeter Capital Management plunged 11 %.
Some investors even pre‑emptively predicted that Situational Awareness might face a forced liquidation and built hedges in advance.

De‑leveraging is only the first step – Aschenbrenner’s next hurdle remains Wall Street. Analysts say the real test for Aschenbrenner is not merely winning back Silicon Valley backing, but regaining the trust of Wall Street financial institutions.
He has announced that all leverage has been removed from the fund and that it no longer uses prime‑brokerage financing to amplify positions.

However, the problem is that if he wants to replicate the ultra‑high returns seen earlier this year, relying solely on internal capital may limit the size and flexibility of his strategies. In other words, a future large‑scale AI bet may still require renewed bank financing and leverage support.

Analysts say this puts him in a delicate position. On one hand, Silicon Valley investors still believe in his long‑term AI vision; on the other, Wall Street will demand proof that he can control leverage, reduce concentration, and build a more mature risk‑management framework.

items.title: 波克夏財報亮眼淨利暴增111%！阿貝爾上任「積極」、由「淨賣方」轉為「淨買方」
items.title_en: Berkshire Hathaway's Earnings Soar 111% as Abel Takes the Helm
paras: 波克夏 (BRK.A-US、BRK.B-US) 週六（8 日）公布最新財報，第二季在股票投資組合帳面獲利大幅回升的帶動下，稅後淨利達到 256.67 億美元，較去年同期的 123.70 億美元成長逾一倍；上半年累計淨利 357.73 億美元，年增率約 111%。這份成績單讓外界觀察到，接任執行長一職的阿貝爾（Greg Abel），正逐步展現與巴菲特（Warren Buffett）時代不同的資金運用節奏。
這波獲利大增主要來自投資收益的貢獻。波克夏第二季稅後投資收益達 126.84 億美元，其中股票部位未實現獲利增加約 109 億美元，另有約 18 億美元的已實現獲利入帳。
相較之下，去年同期因卡夫亨氏 (KHC-US) 投資認列 37.60 億美元減損，重壓了當季獲利表現。
值得一提的是，儘管卡夫亨氏股權的帳面價值目前仍高於市價逾一成，波克夏管理層評估後認為尚未觸及減損門檻，因此本季未再提列相關損失。
撇開投資收益的波動，公司核心的營業利潤同樣穩健成長，第二季達 129.83 億美元，年增約 16%；上半年營運利潤合計 243.29 億美元，成長約 17%。
細看各業務板塊，製造、服務暨零售部門表現最為亮眼，單季貢獻 44.70 億美元，年增達 24%；鐵路子公司 BNSF 貢獻 15.58 億美元，年增約 6%；能源事業則交出 8.91 億美元，成長逾 27%。
相對於實體業務的熱絡，波克夏向來倚重的保險本業則出現降溫跡象。保險承保利潤下滑至 17.31 億美元，保險投資收益也較去年同期減少近 10%。
不過，受惠於美元計價債務匯兌收益由虧轉盈，「其他」類別項目意外挹注 12.74 億美元獲利，成為本季報表中的一大亮點。

一口氣買進近 200 億美元股票，Google 躍居五大重倉

財報最受矚目的焦點，莫過於波克夏罕見地由「淨賣方」轉為「淨買方」。
第二季公司淨買進股票約 198 億美元，其中包含斥資約 100 億美元建立 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 普通股部位，讓 Google 一舉躋身波克夏五大持股之列，並取代雪佛龍 (CVX-US) 的席次。
在與蘋果 (AAPL-US) 、美國運通 (AXP-US) 、美國銀行 (BAC-US) 、可口可樂 (KO-US) 並列後，這五大重倉股合計已占整體股票投資組合 66% 的比重。
值得玩味的是，這筆重倉佈局的時間點，恰好緊接在阿貝爾親自主導、協助 Alphabet 敲定一筆 850 億美元規模融資案之後，顯示這位新任掌舵者在推動大型交易時，出手節奏相當明快。
進一步檢視上半年整體交易，波克夏共買進股票 394.05 億美元、賣出 277.80 億美元，淨買超約 116.25 億美元；相較之下，去年同期還是淨賣出約 45 億美元的狀態。
分析指出，這代表波克夏已正式告別過去數年持續縮減持股、囤積現金的保守姿態，轉向公開市場的積極加碼。
截至 6 月底，波克夏權益類投資公允價值達 3237.79 億美元，較年初增加 260 億美元，帳面浮盈更高達 2172.58 億美元。
除了加碼股市，波克夏第二季同步斥資 45.27 億美元買回自家股票，創下自 2021 年以來單季最大規模的股東回饋，遠高於第一季僅 2.35 億美元的水準；上半年合計回購金額約 47.6 億美元。
觀察月度節奏，波克夏 4 月幾乎沒有動作，5 月才開始小幅進場，到了 6 月則明顯加速，單月即買回逾 714 萬股 B 股（均價約 487.98 美元）以及 413 股 A 股（均價約 73.38 萬美元）。
阿貝爾今年稍早曾對外表示，公司重新啟動庫藏股計畫，是因為管理層判斷波克夏股票的「內在價值」已高於市場交易價格。

波克夏兩筆逾百億元收購案，現金儲備明顯縮水

大手筆加碼股市與回購的同時，波克夏的帳上現金也隨之下滑，截至 6 月 30 日，現金儲備降至 3655 億美元。
除了市場操作，波克夏上半年還完成兩筆重量級實體收購：一月初，公司以約 94 億美元收購西方石油旗下化工業務 OxyChem，並已於第二季開始貢獻約 14 億美元營收；；7 月下旬，波克夏再以每股 72.5 美元、總對價約 68 億美元的現金收購美國知名住宅建商 Taylor Morrison。
分析人士指出，在高利率壓抑房市買氣之際仍出手收購建商，反映出阿貝爾對美國住宅需求長線前景的信心。
綜合來看，兩筆收購合計動用現金約 162 億美元，加上股票淨買超 116 億美元與庫藏股 48 億美元，波克夏在阿貝爾主導下的資本配置腳步，正明顯較過去加快。
paras_en: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A-US, BRK.B-US) reported a significant increase in earnings for the second quarter, driven by a substantial rise in investment gains. Net earnings reached $25.67 billion, more than double the $12.37 billion reported in the same period last year. For the first half of the year, net earnings totaled $35.77 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of 111%.

The significant increase in earnings was primarily driven by investment gains. Berkshire Hathaway's second-quarter net investment gains totaled $12.68 billion, with unrealized gains on equity investments increasing by approximately $10.9 billion and realized gains totaling around $1.8 billion.
In contrast, last year's second quarter was negatively impacted by a $3.76 billion impairment charge related to Kraft Heinz (KHC-US) investments.

Notably, despite Kraft Heinz's stock being valued at over 10% above market price, Berkshire Hathaway's management team assessed that the impairment threshold had not been reached, and therefore did not recognize any further losses in the current quarter.

Excluding investment gains, Berkshire Hathaway's core operating earnings also showed a steady increase, reaching $12.98 billion in the second quarter, representing a year-over-year increase of 16%. For the first half of the year, operating earnings totaled $24.32 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of 17%.

Breaking down the performance by business segment, manufacturing, services, and retail showed the most impressive results, contributing $4.47 billion in the quarter, representing a year-over-year increase of 24%. BNSF Railway contributed $1.56 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of 6%, while the energy segment showed a year-over-year increase of over 27%.

In contrast, Berkshire Hathaway's insurance business, which has historically been a key component of the company's operations, showed a decline in earnings. Insurance underwriting profits decreased to $1.73 billion, and investment gains in the insurance segment were lower by around 10% compared to the same period last year.
However, the company benefited from a reversal of dollar-denominated debt exchange gains, which added $1.27 billion to the 'other' category, making it a significant highlight in the quarterly report.
The most attention-grabbing aspect of the report was Berkshire Hathaway's rare shift from a net seller to a net buyer of stocks.

In the second quarter, the company bought approximately $19.8 billion worth of stocks, including a $10 billion investment in Alphabet (GOOGL-US) common stock, which propelled Google into Berkshire Hathaway's top five holdings, displacing Chevron (CVX-US).
Alongside Apple (AAPL-US), American Express (AXP-US), Bank of America (BAC-US), and Coca-Cola (KO-US), these five stocks now account for 66% of the company's total equity portfolio.

Notably, this significant stock allocation was made shortly after Abel personally led and assisted Alphabet in securing an $85 billion financing deal, demonstrating the new CEO's swift action in driving large transactions.

Looking at the company's overall trading activity for the first half of the year, Berkshire Hathaway bought $39.4 billion worth of stocks and sold $27.78 billion, resulting in a net buying position of $11.62 billion. In contrast, the company was a net seller of $4.5 billion in the same period last year.

Analysts point out that this represents a significant shift away from the company's conservative stance of reducing holdings and accumulating cash over the past few years, and towards a more aggressive approach of actively investing in the market.
As of June 30, Berkshire Hathaway's equity investments had a fair value of $32.37 trillion, up $26 trillion from the beginning of the year, and book value increased to $21.72 trillion.

In addition to increasing its equity investments, Berkshire Hathaway also repurchased $4.57 billion worth of its own shares in the second quarter, the largest quarterly repurchase since 2021, exceeding the $235 million repurchased in the first quarter.

Looking at the monthly rhythm, Berkshire Hathaway was relatively inactive in April, began to make small purchases in May, and accelerated its buying in June, purchasing over 714,000 B shares (average price around $487.98) and 413 A shares (average price around $73.38 million).
Abel had previously stated that the company was restarting its stock buyback program because management believed the company's stock had an intrinsic value higher than its market price.
While Berkshire Hathaway was actively buying stocks and repurchasing its own shares, its cash reserves also declined, falling to $36.55 trillion as of June 30.

In addition to market operations, Berkshire Hathaway completed two significant M&A deals in the first half of the year: a $9.4 billion acquisition of OxyChem, a chemical business owned by Occidental Petroleum, and a $6.8 billion cash acquisition of Taylor Morrison, a well-known US homebuilder.
Analysts point out that the company's willingness to invest in a homebuilder despite the current housing market slowdown reflects Abel's confidence in the long-term demand for US housing.

In summary, the two M&A deals combined used approximately $162 billion in cash, in addition to the $116 billion net buying position and $48 billion in stock buybacks, demonstrating that Berkshire Hathaway's capital allocation under Abel's leadership is accelerating compared to the past.

items.title: 「SaaS末日」來了嗎？AI浪潮下軟體股表現兩極：誰獲勝、誰失敗一次看
items.title_en: Is the "SaaS Apocalypse" Here? Software Stocks Split in the AI Wave: Who Wins and Who Loses at a Glance
paras: 美股軟體類股本週財報季再度上演「幾家歡樂幾家愁」戲碼，市場對於人工智慧（AI）究竟會吃掉傳統軟體即服務（SaaS）業者的生意，還是反過來成為這些公司的成長引擎，看法愈趨分歧。
根據《Business Insider》報導，這波被外界稱為「SaaS 末日論」的疑慮，並未一視同仁地打擊所有軟體股，反而讓市場更精細地篩選出贏家與輸家，而週五（7 日）美股交易正好凸顯了這種分化。
企業協作工具商 Atlassian (TEAM-US) 、雲端通訊業者 Twilio(TWLO-US) 與客服中心軟體商 Five9 公布優於預期的財報後，週五收盤股價分別大漲 35.31%、24.89% 與 19.81%。
相較之下，行銷與客服軟體公司 HubSpot(HUBS-US) 週五收盤只上漲 3.96%。
分析人士指出，「AI 取代 SaaS」的敘事今年以來曾多次衝擊上述幾家公司股價，但隨著時間，市場逐漸看出更細膩的圖像：部分軟體公司握有較深的護城河，難以被輕易取代。
此外，許多業者也積極將 AI 功能整合進既有產品線，反而創造新的營收動能；至於個別公司股價的漲跌，往往還摻雜了各自獨特的營運變數。

Atlassian：執行長加碼買股 展現信心

旗下擁有 Jira、Confluence 等企業工作管理工具的 Atlassian，在財報大幅超越華爾街預期後，週五收盤大漲 35.31%。
公司第四季營收年增 28%，達 17.7 億美元，優於分析師預估的 16.6 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 1.87 美元，同樣勝過市場預期的 1.50 美元。
雲端業務營收則成長 31% 至 12 億美元。公司指出，雲端採用持續強勁，以及 AI 驅動的產品需求，是支撐未來展望的主要動能。
執行長 Mike Cannon-Brookes 向投資人表示，他計畫買進 2.5 億美元的 Atlassian 股票，以實際行動展現信心，認為公司有能力挺過「SaaS 末日」。

Twilio：AI 語音與訊息需求助攻 自由現金流創新高

雲端通訊平台公司 Twilio，週五收盤大漲 24.89%。
公司公布第二季營收 15 億美元，年增 22%，優於分析師預估的 14.3 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 1.47 美元，同樣超越市場預期的 1.32 美元。
值得注意的是，Twilio 單季自由現金流達 3.53 億美元，創下歷史新高。
公司對第三季營收的預測區間中值為 15.1 億美元，高於華爾街約 14.7 億美元的預估。管理層表示，AI 語音與訊息服務需求暢旺，帶動有機成長率加速至 17%。

Five9：AI 營收暴增 78% 但獲利能力承壓

雲端客服中心軟體商 Five9 財報表現溫和優於預期，週五收盤上漲 19.81%。不過，在盤前交易，Five9 股價僅小幅上漲約 1.7%。
公司第二季營收年增 10% 至 3.124 億美元，超越市場預估的 3.066 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 70 美分，也比市場預期高出約 2 美分。
細看財報內容，Five9 訂閱業務營收成長 14%，AI 相關營收更是暴增 78%，展現轉型動能。
不過，公司獲利能力出現隱憂，調整後毛利率從去年同期的 63% 收斂至 61.4%，調整後每股盈餘也較去年同期的 76 美分下滑至 70 美分。

HubSpot：財測不如預期 銷售週期拉長

以行銷、銷售與客戶服務軟體聞名的 HubSpo 週五收盤小幅上漲 3.96%，但仍難以挽回週四（6 日）暴跌 19% 的頹勢。
公司第二季營收年增 20% 至 9.117 億美元，優於市場預估的 8.983 億美元；調整後每股盈餘 3.26 美元，同樣勝過分析師預期的 3.02 美元。
然而，HubSpot 對第三季營收的財測低於華爾街預期。公司預估第三季營收將介於 9.24 億至 9.25 億美元，低於分析師約 9.41 億美元的預期，同時將全年營收財測中值下調了 2,200 萬美元。
執行長 Yamini Rangan 在財報電話會議上表示，定價與產品調整拉長了客戶的採購流程，而客戶預算趨於緊縮，也導致銷售週期延長。
財務長 Kate Bueker 表示，HubSpot 第二季新增 7,000 名客戶，低於公司原先預期的 9,000 至 1 萬名。
paras_en: U.S. software stocks again staged a "some celebrate, some worry" drama this week’s earnings season, as the market’s view diverges on whether artificial intelligence (AI) will eat away the business of traditional software‑as‑a‑service (SaaS) firms or become a growth engine for them.

According to Business Insider, the concern dubbed the "SaaS apocalypse" has not hit all software stocks uniformly; instead it has prompted the market to sift more finely for winners and losers, and Friday’s (the 7th) U.S. trading highlighted that split.

Enterprise collaboration tool maker Atlassian (TEAM‑US), cloud communications provider Twilio (TWLO‑US) and contact‑center software vendor Five9 all posted earnings that beat expectations, sending their shares up 35.31%, 24.89% and 19.81% respectively at Friday’s close.
By contrast, marketing and customer‑service software company HubSpot (HUBS‑US) rose only 3.96% at Friday’s close.

Analysts note that the narrative of "AI replacing SaaS" has knocked the stocks of the companies above several times this year, but over time the market is seeing a more nuanced picture: some software firms have deeper moats that are hard to erode.

Moreover, many players are actively embedding AI features into existing product lines, creating new revenue momentum; the price moves of individual stocks often also reflect each company’s unique operational variables.

Atlassian: CEO Increases Share Purchases to Show Confidence
Atlassian, which owns enterprise work‑management tools such as Jira and Confluence, saw its stock jump 35.31% after its earnings far exceeded Wall Street forecasts.
The company’s fourth‑quarter revenue grew 28% year‑over‑year to $1.77 billion, beating analysts’ estimate of $1.66 billion; adjusted earnings per share were $1.87, also ahead of the $1.50 consensus.
Cloud‑services revenue rose 31% to $1.2 billion. The firm said strong cloud adoption and AI‑driven product demand are the main drivers of its outlook.
CEO Mike Cannon‑Brookes told investors he plans to buy $250 million of Atlassian stock, using actual purchases to demonstrate confidence that the company can survive a "SaaS apocalypse."

Twilio: AI Voice and Messaging Demand Fuels Gains, Free Cash Flow Hits Record High
Cloud communications platform Twilio surged 24.89% at Friday’s close.
The company reported second‑quarter revenue of $1.5 billion, up 22% year‑over‑year and ahead of the $1.43 billion analysts expected; adjusted EPS was $1.47, also above the $1.32 forecast.
Notably, Twilio’s free cash flow for the quarter reached $353 million, a historic high.

For the third quarter, Twilio projects revenue around $1.51 billion, above Wall Street’s roughly $1.47 billion estimate. Management said strong demand for AI‑driven voice and messaging services is accelerating organic growth to 17%.

Five9: AI Revenue Soars 78% but Profitability Under Pressure
Contact‑center software provider Five9 posted modestly better‑than‑expected earnings, with its stock up 19.81% at Friday’s close. In pre‑market trading, the stock was up only about 1.7%.
Second‑quarter revenue grew 10% year‑over‑year to $312.4 million, topping the market’s $306.6 million estimate; adjusted EPS was $0.70, roughly $0.02 above expectations.
A deeper look shows Five9’s subscription revenue grew 14% while AI‑related revenue exploded 78%, highlighting transformation momentum.
However, profitability showed signs of strain, with adjusted gross margin narrowing from 63% a year ago to 61.4%, and adjusted EPS falling from $0.76 to $0.70 year‑over‑year.

HubSpot: Outlook Misses Expectations, Sales Cycle Lengthens
HubSpot, known for marketing, sales and customer‑service software, rose only 3.96% at Friday’s close, still unable to recover from a 19% plunge on Thursday (the 6th).
Second‑quarter revenue rose 20% year‑over‑year to $911.7 million, beating the $898.3 million consensus; adjusted EPS was $3.26, also above the $3.02 forecast.

Nevertheless, HubSpot’s third‑quarter revenue guidance fell short of Wall Street’s expectations. The company forecast Q3 revenue between $924 million and $925 million, below analysts’ roughly $941 million estimate, and trimmed the midpoint of its full‑year revenue outlook by $22 million.
CEO Yamini Rangan said in the earnings call that pricing and product adjustments have lengthened customers’ purchasing cycles, and tighter budgets have also extended the sales cycle.
CFO Kate Bueker noted that HubSpot added 7,000 new customers in Q2, below the company’s original expectation of 9,000 to 10,000.

items.title: 蘋果正式牽手阿里！Apple Intelligence整合「千問」　Siri可直接調用
items.title_en: Apple Partners with Alibaba: Apple Intelligence Integrates 'Qwen' Model, Siri Can Directly Call
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 與阿里巴巴 (09988-HK) 的人工智慧（AI）合作，如今已不再只是傳聞或監管文件上的字眼，而是實際寫進了蘋果官方的產品說明之中。
近日有網友發現，蘋果中國官網的《Mac 使用手冊》新增一個頁面，標題直白寫著「在 Mac 上配合蘋果智慧使用通義千問」。
這代表，阿里的大型語言模型「千問」已正式成為中國版 Apple Intelligence 系統中不可或缺的一環。
根據蘋果的說明，千問並非以獨立應用程式的形式出現在使用者眼前，而是深度嵌入 Apple Intelligence 的核心功能。
舉例來說，當 Siri 無法完整回答某些較複雜的提問時，系統會在背後呼叫千問來補強回覆內容，包括對照片與文件進行深入分析；在蘋果的寫作工具中，使用者同樣可以透過千問，依文字描述生成文字或圖像內容。
換句話說，多數使用者可能根本不需要主動開啟千問 App，只要在日常使用 Siri 提問、分析文件或啟動 AI 寫作功能時，就有機會在不知不覺間用上這套中國本土模型的運算能力。
事實上，蘋果與阿里的合作早有跡象可循。今年七月，《路透》報導指出，Apple Intelligence 相關的生成式 AI 服務已完成中國監管部門的備案程序；為符合中國市場法規要求，蘋果選擇同時與阿里巴巴、百度 (BIDU-US) 合作，其中阿里的千問模型將被整合進 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 與 visionOS 等多個系統平台。
《華爾街日報》稍早也曾報導，蘋果自 2025 年初便著手推進相關監管程序，並與阿里、百度共同開發針對中國市場設計的 AI 功能。
不過，此前外界所知多半停留在「誰與蘋果合作」的層面。這次官方使用手冊的更新，則首度將合作內容具體落實到使用者體驗上。
Siri 能調用千問，寫作工具也能調用千問，這代表千問所獲得的，並不僅僅是「預裝 App」的位置，而是切入了蘋果系統最核心的 AI 入口。
分析指出，這起合作背後，反映的是蘋果 AI 策略的一次根本轉向。
過去的智慧型手機時代，蘋果向來習慣將核心軟體能力牢牢握在自己手中：晶片自行設計、作業系統自行開發、Siri 也是自家產品。
然而，進入生成式 AI 時代後，大型模型更新速度飛快、訓練成本居高不下，加上各國監管與資料規範差異極大，蘋果因此開始將 Apple Intelligence 打造成更具彈性的分層架構。
在最底層，蘋果仍仰賴自研的 Apple Silicon 晶片與裝置端模型處理大量個人化任務，並持續強調裝置端運算對隱私保護的重要性；但當使用者提出的問題較為複雜、需要更強大的模型能力時，系統便會轉而呼叫外部模型支援。
這種做法蘋果在海外市場其實已有先例，如今則將角色交棒給中國本土 AI 廠商。
也就是說，蘋果正嘗試建立一條全新的「AI 供應鏈」：自己掌控作業系統、硬體與使用者入口，底層模型能力則依市場需求選擇不同供應商。

對阿里而言：比裝進 iPhone 更重要的位置

對阿里巴巴來說，這次合作的意義同樣深遠。
分析指出，過去一年，中國大型模型市場競爭日趨白熱化，各家廠商不僅比拚模型能力, 更積極爭奪使用者入口。
阿里自家的千問 App 持續擴充辦公、生活服務、AI 代理與圖像影片生成等功能，試圖直接對消費者端發力。
然而，蘋果所提供的，卻是完全不同性質的入口。它不需要使用者特意想到「我要用 AI」再另外開啟應用程式，而是讓 AI 直接融入使用者原本就在使用的系統功能之中。
分析認為，這等於是把大型模型從一項獨立產品，轉化為作業系統背後的基礎能力。
值得一提的是，英國《金融時報》本週在分析阿里最新模型 Qwen 3.8-Max 時也指出，阿里正嘗試將 AI 打造為新的技術與商業成長引擎，阿里雲則在模型能力商業化過程中扮演關鍵角色。
若未來數以千萬計的中國蘋果裝置都能透過系統功能呼叫千問，阿里所獲得的將不只是龐大的調用量，更包含一項極具份量的產業背書，證明其大型模型有能力成為全球最大消費電子生態系之一的底層 AI 供應商。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) and Alibaba (09988-HK) have been collaborating on artificial intelligence (AI) projects, and this collaboration is no longer just a rumor or a regulatory filing, but is now officially written into Apple's product documentation.
Recently, a netizen discovered that Apple's official Chinese website has added a new page to the Mac user manual, titled 'Using Apple Intelligence with Qwen on Mac'.
This means that Alibaba's large language model, Qwen, has officially become an essential component of the Apple Intelligence system in China.
According to Apple's explanation, Qwen is not presented as a standalone application, but is deeply embedded in the core functionality of Apple Intelligence.

For example, when Siri is unable to fully answer a complex question, the system will call Qwen in the background to supplement the response content, including in-depth analysis of photos and files; in Apple's writing tools, users can also use Qwen to generate text or image content based on text descriptions.

In other words, most users may not need to actively open the Qwen app, but can use the Chinese native model's computing power in the background when using Siri to ask questions, analyze files, or activate AI writing functions.

In fact, Apple and Alibaba's collaboration has been evident for some time. In July, Reuters reported that Apple Intelligence-related generative AI services had completed the registration process with Chinese regulatory authorities; to meet the requirements of the Chinese market, Apple chose to cooperate with Alibaba and Baidu (BIDU-US) simultaneously, with Alibaba's Qwen model being integrated into iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS, among other system platforms.

The Wall Street Journal had previously reported that Apple had begun pushing related regulatory procedures as early as January 2025 and was working with Alibaba and Baidu to develop AI functions tailored for the Chinese market.

However, prior to this, most of the information known to the outside world was limited to 'who is cooperating with Apple.' This time, the official update of the user manual has brought the cooperation content to the user experience for the first time.

Siri can call Qwen, and the writing tool can also call Qwen, which means that Qwen's capabilities are not limited to being a 'pre-installed app,' but have entered the core AI entry point of the Apple system.
Analysts point out that this cooperation reflects a fundamental shift in Apple's AI strategy.

In the era of intelligent phones, Apple has always preferred to keep core software capabilities in its own hands: designing its own chips, developing its own operating systems, and Siri is also a self-owned product.

However, with the advent of generative AI, large models update at a rapid pace, training costs are high, and there are significant differences in regulations and data standards across countries, Apple has begun to transform Apple Intelligence into a more flexible, multi-layered architecture.

At the bottom layer, Apple still relies on its self-designed Apple Silicon chips and device-end models to handle a large number of personalized tasks, and continues to emphasize the importance of device-end computation for privacy protection; but when users ask complex questions that require more powerful model capabilities, the system will call external models for support.
This approach has already been seen in Apple's overseas markets, and now it is passing the baton to Chinese native AI vendors.

In other words, Apple is trying to establish a new 'AI supply chain': controlling the operating system, hardware, and user interface, while relying on different suppliers for bottom-layer model capabilities based on market demand.
For Alibaba, this cooperation has a deeper significance.

Analysts point out that over the past year, the Chinese large model market has become increasingly competitive, with various vendors not only competing in model capabilities but also actively competing for user entry points.
Alibaba's own Qwen app has been continuously expanding its office, life services, AI agents, and image and video generation functions, trying to directly attack the consumer end.

However, Apple's offering is of a completely different nature. It does not require users to think 'I want to use AI' and then open an application separately, but instead integrates AI directly into the user's existing system functions.
Analysts believe that this is equivalent to transforming large models from a standalone product to a fundamental capability behind the operating system.

It's worth noting that the Financial Times analyzed Alibaba's latest model Qwen 3.8-Max this week and pointed out that Alibaba is trying to turn AI into a new technology and business growth engine, with Alibaba Cloud playing a key role in the commercialization of model capabilities.

If millions of Apple devices in China can call Qwen through system functions in the future, Alibaba will not only gain a massive number of calls, but also a significant industry endorsement, proving that its large model has the ability to become a bottom-layer AI supplier for one of the world's largest consumer electronics ecosystems.

items.title: CPU恐成雲端業下一個瓶頸！亞馬遜AWS出現「CPU短缺」
items.title_en: CPU May Become the Next Bottleneck for Cloud Industry as Amazon AWS Faces "CPU Shortage"
paras: 科技業已經從聚焦於 GPU 一片難求的窘境，轉向 CPU 這項基礎運算資源。
根據《The Information》報導，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 雲端服務（AWS）內部今年 5 月已對工程團隊發出示警，要求全力節省運算資源，以確保未來能持續滿足客戶需求。
值得注意的是，這波節流令不僅鎖定 AI 晶片，更直指長年支撐網路服務運作的傳統 CPU 伺服器。
知情人士透露，AWS 已對各部門下達期限，要求在今年稍晚前削減運算資源的占用比例。為了騰出算力轉供外部客戶使用，工程師們正陸續關閉先前用於軟體開發、如今處於閒置狀態的 EC2 虛擬伺服器。
一名任職 AWS 多年的工程師表示，過去申請 CPU 伺服器資源通常數小時內就能到位，如今卻得苦候數天之久，這樣的延遲在他的職涯中前所未見，甚至可能拖累專案交付時程。
對此，AWS 官方回應強調，儘管當前面臨「龐大需求」，公司仍有能力滿足「絕大多數」內外部客戶的運算需求，並表示正與內部團隊密切合作，確保 EC2 資源維持一貫的高效運用，員工使用資源的相關指引也未因目前的緊張情勢而調整。
值得留意的是，外部客戶目前受到的衝擊仍屬有限。一名協助企業導入 AWS 服務的顧問指出，尚未觀察到客戶在合約承諾的算力上出現實際短缺。
不過，AWS 以折扣價提供、但可隨時在兩分鐘內被收回的「競價執行個體」（Spot Instances），近幾個月來已越來越難大量取得，被視為 AWS 整體供需缺口正在收窄、彈性空間持續壓縮的明確訊號，也可能預示雲端運算成本即將走高。
分析指出，這波 CPU 吃緊的根本原因，在於「AI 代理」應用的快速擴散。AI 顧問公司 Elendil Labs 共同創辦人暨董事總經理 Jing Xie 觀察到，客戶的人均 IT 支出已然翻倍，主因正是企業內大量導入 AI 代理程式協助軟體開發。
他指出，AI 代理程式在運作過程中往往需要調用比以往更多的雲端資源，進而對 CPU 形成持續性的龐大需求。
他表示：「不論是現在的開發、生產或營運，幾乎所有工作所需的 CPU 都比過去更多。」
事實上，CPU 的角色不僅限於 AI 應用的執行端，在 AI 開發流程中同樣不可或缺。例如 AI 公司為訓練模型準備資料時，仍須仰賴 CPU 從文件、影像與影片中讀取並處理原始資料。
晶片大廠的最新表態也印證了這股趨勢。英特爾 (INTC-US) 執行長陳立武（Lip-Bu Tan）今年 4 月的財報電話會議上曾透露，在 AI 推論（即模型實際運作）情境中，CPU 與 GPU 的使用比例約為 1 比 4。
然而，到了 7 月，該公司財務長 David Zinsner 便指出這項比例已迅速拉近至接近 1 比 1。
超微半導體 (AMD-US) 與 Arm(ARM-US) 的高層主管近期也做出類似表態，顯示 CPU 需求成長的速度已超出業界原先預期。
除了 CPU 本身供不應求，與之搭配使用的記憶體晶片供應緊張，以及資料中心實體空間的限制，也共同加劇了這場算力荒。
大型科技公司的算力分配難題
如何在內部研發與外部客戶之間分配有限算力，已成為近兩年科技巨頭共同面臨的棘手課題。
根據《The Information》先前報導，Google 去年已成立一個由高階主管組成的專責委員會，負責協調 Google Cloud、DeepMind 研究部門與消費端業務之間的運算資源分配。
即便如此，內部摩擦仍未消弭。Google 知名 AI 研究員 Noam Shazeer 今年稍早便因不滿算力取得受限而選擇離職。
相較之下，微軟則展現出算力管理效率提升所帶來的正面效益。該公司財務長 Amy Hood 上月在財報電話會議上表示，Azure 雲端服務部分營收成長，正是得益於 CPU 與 GPU 叢集管理效率的提升。
paras_en: The tech industry has shifted its focus from the scarce GPU shortage to the fundamental computing resource of CPUs.

According to a report by The Information, Amazon (AMZN-US) cloud services (AWS) internally issued a warning to engineering teams in May of this year, urging them to conserve computing resources to ensure continued customer demand can be met.
Notably, this throttling effort targets not only AI chips but also the traditional CPU servers that have long underpinned network services.

Sources familiar with the matter say AWS has set deadlines for each division to reduce the proportion of computing resources they consume later this year. To free up capacity for external customers, engineers are gradually shutting down EC2 virtual servers that were previously used for software development and are now idle.

An engineer who has worked at AWS for many years said that in the past, requesting CPU server resources could be fulfilled within a few hours, but now it can take several days—a delay he has never seen in his career and one that could even jeopardize project delivery timelines.

AWS responded that despite the "massive demand" currently faced, the company remains capable of meeting the computing needs of "the vast majority" of internal and external customers, and that it is working closely with internal teams to keep EC2 resources efficiently utilized, with no changes to employee resource‑use guidelines despite the current tight situation.

It is worth noting that the impact on external customers remains limited. A consultant who helps enterprises adopt AWS services said he has not yet observed any actual shortfall in the compute capacity promised under customer contracts.

However, AWS’s discounted Spot Instances, which can be reclaimed at any time within two minutes, have become increasingly difficult to obtain in large quantities over the past few months, a clear sign that the overall supply‑demand gap is narrowing and flexibility is being squeezed, potentially foreshadowing higher cloud‑computing costs.

Analysts point out that the root cause of the CPU crunch is the rapid proliferation of "AI agents" applications. Jing Xie, co‑founder and managing director of AI consultancy Elendil Labs, observed that per‑capita IT spending by customers has doubled, driven largely by the massive adoption of AI agent programs to assist software development within enterprises.
He noted that AI agent programs typically require far more cloud resources during operation, creating a sustained, massive demand for CPUs.
He said, "Whether in development, production, or operations, almost every task now needs more CPU than before."

In fact, the role of CPUs extends beyond the execution side of AI applications; they are also indispensable in the AI development pipeline. For example, when AI companies prepare data for model training, they still rely on CPUs to read and process raw data from documents, images, and videos.

The latest statements from chip makers confirm this trend. Intel (INTC-US) CEO Lip‑Bu Tan disclosed in the April earnings call that in AI inference scenarios, the CPU‑to‑GPU usage ratio is about 1 to 4.
However, by July, the company’s CFO David Zinsner noted that the ratio had quickly narrowed to nearly 1 to 1.
Senior executives at AMD (AMD-US) and Arm (ARM-US) have made similar remarks recently, indicating that CPU demand growth is outpacing industry expectations.
In addition to the shortage of CPUs themselves, tight supplies of memory chips used alongside them and constraints on physical data‑center space are jointly exacerbating this compute scarcity.
Large tech companies face compute allocation challenges
How to allocate limited compute between internal R&D and external customers has become a thorny issue that major tech giants have grappled with over the past two years.

According to earlier reporting by The Information, Google established a high‑level committee last year to coordinate compute resource allocation among Google Cloud, DeepMind research, and consumer‑facing businesses.
Nevertheless, internal friction persists. Google AI researcher Noam Shazeer left the company earlier this year over frustrations with limited compute access.

In contrast, Microsoft has demonstrated the positive effects of improved compute management efficiency. CFO Amy Hood said last month in the earnings call that Azure’s revenue growth was driven in part by better CPU and GPU cluster management.

items.title: 輝達砸30億美元押注AI電力基建！傳入股Lancium 20%、布局「星際之門」資料中心
items.title_en: Nvidia Pours $3 B into AI Power Infrastructure, Takes 20% Stake in Lancium and Plans “Stargate” Data Center
paras: 人工智慧（AI）晶片龍頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 傳出將對電力基礎建設開發商 Lancium 挹注最高 30 億美元資金，這家公司正是德州「星際之門」（Stargate）資料中心園區的幕後推手。
根據《The Information》報導，報導引述知情人士說法指出，輝達首波將投入 20 億美元，取得 Lancium 約 20% 股權。
Lancium 背後金主為私募巨頭黑石集團（Blackstone），若後續達成特定門檻，例如電網併接進度符合預期，輝達不排除再加碼 10 億美元。
以此次交易計算，Lancium 旗下土地與電力連結資產組合，企業價值約達 100 億美元。
報導指出，這筆資金將協助 Lancium 加速業務擴張，該公司目前正評估在 2027 年推動首次公開發行（IPO）的可能性。
截至目前，輝達與 Lancium 均未對外界的求證要求作出回應。
值得注意的是，Lancium 正是「星際之門」計畫的關鍵基礎建設夥伴。該計畫由軟銀（SoftBank）、OpenAI 與甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 三方合資推動，目標是打造支撐 AI 發展的大型資料中心網路。
美國總統川普今年 1 月宣布此案時曾表示，相關企業合計將投入最高 5000 億美元資金，用於建設 AI 所需的基礎設施。
Lancium 目前在德州阿比林（Abilene）擁有一座占地 1000 英畝的「Lancium 潔淨園區」，該園區也是「星際之門」計畫首個正式啟用的營運據點。
paras_en: AI chip leader Nvidia (NVDA-US) is reported to be injecting up to $3 billion into power‑infrastructure developer Lancium, the company behind Texas’s “Stargate” data‑center campus.
According to The Information, insiders say Nvidia’s first tranche will be $2 billion for roughly a 20% equity stake in Lancium.
Lancium’s backer is private‑equity giant Blackstone, and if certain milestones—such as grid‑connection progress—are met, Nvidia may add another $1 billion.
Based on the deal, Lancium’s land and power‑linked asset portfolio is valued at about $10 billion.
The funding will help Lancium accelerate its expansion, and the firm is currently evaluating the possibility of an initial public offering in 2027.
To date, neither Nvidia nor Lancium has responded to external verification requests.

It is notable that Lancium is the key infrastructure partner for the “Stargate” project, a joint venture by SoftBank, OpenAI and Oracle (ORCL-US) aimed at building a large data‑center network to support AI development.
When President Trump announced the project in January, he said the participating companies could collectively invest up to $500 billion in AI‑related infrastructure.
Lancium currently operates a 1,000‑acre “Lancium Clean Campus” in Abilene, Texas, which is the first operational site of the “Stargate” initiative.

items.title: 美國、中國AI投資收益有限！台灣、南韓、日本成最大贏家？
items.title_en: Limited Returns from US and China AI Investments! Taiwan, South Korea, and Japan as the Biggest Winners?
paras: 中美兩國近年競相投入天文數字的人工智慧（AI）建設資金，這股熱潮如今已具體反映在各地的經濟數據上，但受惠程度卻呈現明顯落差。美國雖是投資規模最大的國家, 實際拉抬經濟成長的效果卻相對有限；反倒是南韓、台灣、日本等半導體出口重鎮，短期內享受到遠超預期的成長紅利。
根據史丹佛大學「以人為本人工智慧研究院」（HAI）統計，2013 年至 2025 年間，美國民間累計投資 AI 相關領域達 7572 億美元，穩居全球之冠，其中光是 2025 年一年就砸下 2858 億美元，占比逼近四成。
中國則以 1318 億美元緊追在後，規模不到美國的兩成，不過若計入官方基金投入，實際金額恐怕不止於此。
儘管資金瘋狂湧入，美國經濟成長受惠的幅度卻不如表面數字亮眼。摩根士丹利估算，數據中心等 AI 相關支出原本可將美國 GDP 成長率推升 1.37 個百分點，但由於美國建設數據中心所需的先進晶片與通訊設備高度仰賴進口，一旦扣除進口增加對成長率造成的負面拖累，AI 投資對美國經濟的實質貢獻，恐怕僅剩 0.16 個百分點。
值得留意的是，隨著數據中心建設案接連上馬，尖端晶片與伺服器供不應求，價格節節攀升，連帶讓搭載相關晶片的產品與服務也承受漲價壓力。
美國聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）曾多次強調，AI 普及長期而言有助於提升生產力並壓低物價，但就眼前情勢來看，需求擴張帶來的漲價效應顯然更為明顯。
聯準會理事沃勒（Christopher Waller）甚至警告，若 AI 投資持續狂飆，恐怕反倒會成為推升通膨的新變數。
相較之下，中國的情況又是另一番景象。當地將 AI 與高科技技術導入工廠及物流體系，帶動工業生產與出口競爭力雙雙提升。
國際金融協會（IIF）分析指出，數據中心建設、通訊設備生產等數位產業，如今已占中國 GDP 逾一成，近年更平均為整體經濟成長貢獻了將近 1 個百分點的動能。
不過，這股力道仍不足以填補房地產市場低迷所留下的內需缺口，「AI 提升生產力、進而帶動薪資成長」的良性循環，在中國也尚未真正成形。
與美國類似，中國在 AI 投資所需的高階晶片上同樣長期依賴進口，半導體貿易收支持續處於逆差狀態。
值得注意的是，真正嚐到甜頭的，反而是在半導體出口上具備優勢的南韓、台灣等經濟體。
國際貨幣基金（IMF）最新一期《世界經濟展望》顯示，南韓、台灣、泰國、馬來西亞今年第一季的 GDP 年化季增率，平均較 IMF 原先預測高出 4.4 個百分點。
其中南韓表現最為突出，季增年化率達 7.5%，足足是 IMF 預測值的四倍；台灣今年上半年出口額則較去年同期大增 47%，其中約八成來自伺服器、半導體等資訊科技設備，顯示 AI 需求的強勁拉動效應。
日本也可望在半導體製造設備與電子零組件出口上跟著沾光。野村證券經濟學家伊藤勇輝估算，若亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 等美國科技巨頭依原訂計畫推進 2026 年的 AI 投資，日本相關出口有機會因此成長 17%。
外界普遍期待，這波 AI 熱潮能重現 1990 年代美國「無通膨式經濟成長」的榮景，長遠來看確實存在強勁拉抬美國經濟的可能性。
不過，市場同時也擔憂，AI 對企業獲利與生產力的實際改善程度，恐怕不如預期樂觀。
事實上，先前過熱的 AI 相關投機資金自 7 月起已出現逆轉跡象，全球股市中的 AI 與半導體概念股跌勢加劇，「AI 投資是否過熱」的疑慮正逐漸浮上檯面。
IMF 也提出警示，一旦市場對 AI 前景的預期降溫，除了美國、中國等投資主力國家之外，南韓等身為半導體供應鏈要角的經濟體，同樣可能面臨股市進入修正、股價下跌抑制消費動能的風險。
paras_en: In recent years the United States and China have poured astronomical sums into AI development, a wave now reflected in economic data worldwide, but the benefits have been uneven. While the US invests the most, its impact on economic growth is relatively modest; by contrast semiconductor-export powerhouses such as South Korea, Taiwan and Japan are enjoying short‑term growth dividends far beyond expectations.

According to Stanford University's Institute for Human‑Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI), private AI investment in the United States totaled $757.2 billion from 2013 to 2025, the highest in the world, with $285.8 billion poured in just in 2025—almost 40% of the cumulative total.
China follows with $131.8 billion, less than 20% of the US figure, though official fund contributions likely push the true amount higher.

Despite the flood of capital, the boost to US economic growth is less striking than the headline numbers suggest. Morgan Stanley estimates that AI‑related spending such as data‑center construction could lift US GDP growth by 1.37 percentage points, but because the advanced chips and communications gear needed are heavily imported, the net contribution after accounting for the drag from imports falls to only about 0.16 percentage points.

It is worth noting that as data‑center projects roll out, demand for cutting‑edge chips and servers outstrips supply, driving up prices and passing cost pressures onto products and services that rely on those components.

Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has repeatedly stressed that AI diffusion will ultimately raise productivity and lower prices, but given current conditions the inflationary impact of expanding demand is far more evident.
Fed Governor Christopher Waller even warned that if AI investment continues to surge, it could become a new source of inflationary pressure.
China’s situation, by contrast, looks different. The country is integrating AI and high‑tech tools into factories and logistics, boosting both industrial output and export competitiveness.

The International Institute of Finance (IIF) notes that digital industries such as data‑center construction and communications equipment now account for more than 10% of China’s GDP and have contributed roughly 1 percentage point of growth momentum in recent years.

However, that force is still insufficient to fill the domestic‑demand gap left by a sluggish real‑estate market; the virtuous cycle of “AI raising productivity, which in turn lifts wages” has not yet materialised in China.
Like the United States, China also relies heavily on imported high‑end chips for AI investment, keeping its semiconductor trade balance in a persistent deficit.
The real beneficiaries are economies with semiconductor export advantages, such as South Korea and Taiwan.

The latest IMF World Economic Outlook shows that South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand and Malaysia all posted first‑quarter 2024 GDP annualised growth rates that averaged 4.4 percentage points above the IMF’s own forecasts.

South Korea stood out with an annualised quarterly growth rate of 7.5%, four times the IMF’s estimate; Taiwan’s exports in the first half of the year jumped 47% year‑on‑year, about 80% of which came from servers, semiconductors and other IT equipment, underscoring the strong pull of AI demand.

Japan is also poised to benefit from semiconductor‑manufacturing equipment and electronic component exports. Nomura economist Yuuki Ito estimates that if US tech giants such as Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) proceed with their planned 2026 AI investments, Japan’s related exports could grow by as much as 17%.
Many expect this AI boom to recreate the 1990s US “growth without inflation” era, and in the long run it could indeed provide a powerful lift to the US economy.
Nevertheless, markets also worry that AI’s actual impact on corporate profits and productivity may fall short of optimistic expectations.

In fact, speculative AI‑related capital that had overheated began to reverse in July, with AI and semiconductor stocks falling faster in global markets, bringing the question of whether AI investment is over‑heated to the fore.

The IMF also warned that if market expectations for AI cool, not only the major investor nations like the US and China but also semiconductor‑chain economies such as South Korea could see stock‑market corrections and falling share prices that dampen consumer momentum.

items.title: SK海力士擬砸710億美元回饋股東！40%買庫藏股、相當於美股發行規模
items.title_en: SK Hynix Plans $71 B Shareholder Return, 40% Buyback Equivalent to Its US ADR Issuance Size
paras: 南韓高頻寬記憶體（HBM）巨頭 SK 海力士 (000660KS) 傳出將啟動公司史上規模最大的股東回饋計畫。
根據《韓國經濟》稍早披露的內容，SK 海力士內部正評估總額約 100 兆韓元（710 億美元）的股東回饋方案，其中包含約 40 兆韓元的庫藏股買回計畫。
若換算成占股本比重，這筆買回金額大約相當於總股本的 2% 出頭，規模幾乎與該公司此前在美國市場發行存託憑證（ADR）的籌資規模相近。
若最終方案定案並落實，其規模將明顯超越去年公司投入現金股息與庫藏股註銷合計約 14.3 兆韓元的水準。
業界人士分析，此次規劃中的 40 兆韓元庫藏股買回，佔總股本比重略高於 2%，數字恰好貼近該公司為發行 ADR 而增發新股、稀釋約 2.5% 股本的幅度。市場因此普遍解讀，這波回購動作實質上是 SK 海力士用來對沖 ADR 增資所帶來股權稀釋效應的手段。
對照去年數據，SK 海力士全年現金股息支出為 2.1 兆韓元，加計庫藏股註銷 12.2 兆韓元, 兩項合計約 14.3 兆韓元，相當於總股本約 2.1% 遭到註銷。
換言之，若這次百兆韓元方案如期兌現，單一年度的股東回饋規模將是去年的數倍之多。
在例行股息方面，SK 海力士 7 日公告本季每股將配發現金股息 375 韓元，股息總額達 2733 億韓元，以普通股計算殖利率約 0.02%。除息基準日訂於本月 31 日，公司預計將於基準日後一個月內完成派息作業。
值得留意的是，公司同步在公告中透露，目前正研擬能進一步提升股東價值的追加回饋方案, 並預告具體內容將於第三季拍板公布。
這代表原先外界預期要等到年底才會揭曉的計畫，時程已明顯提前，也被視為公司對股東釋出的積極訊號。
分析指出，SK 海力士敢於端出如此大手筆的回饋方案，底氣主要來自其在 HBM 市場近乎壟斷的領先地位，以及隨之而來、被市場高度看好的獲利前景。
金融資訊平台 EpicAI 預估，SK 海力士今年營收上看 345.6 兆韓元、營業利益約 266.4 兆韓元，分別較去年大增約 256% 與 464%，成長幅度相當驚人。
該公司高層上月在第二季財報電話會議上也明確表示，下半年隨著第六代 HBM 產品 HBM4 出貨量顯著放量，加上尖端通用型 DRAM 出貨同步增加，預期下半年整體出貨表現將優於上半年。
這番說法也為市場對這項超大規模股東回饋方案的期待,，提供了實質的基本面支撐。
paras_en: South Korean high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) giant SK Hynix (000660KS) is reported to be launching the largest shareholder‑return program in the company’s history.

According to a recent report by the Korea Economic Daily, SK Hynix is internally evaluating a shareholder‑return plan worth roughly 100 trillion won (about $71 billion), which includes a buy‑back of about 40 trillion won of its own shares.

Converted to a percentage of equity, that buy‑back would represent just over 2% of total share capital, a scale almost equal to the amount the company raised when it issued American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in the U.S. market.
If the final plan is approved and implemented, its size would clearly exceed last year’s combined cash dividend and share‑cancellation amount of roughly 14.3 trillion won.

Industry analysts note that the planned 40 trillion‑won buy‑back, slightly above 2% of total equity, closely matches the dilution from the new shares issued to support the ADR program, which diluted the share base by about 2.5%. The market therefore reads the repurchase as a hedge against that dilution effect.

By comparison, last year SK Hynix spent 2.1 trillion won on cash dividends and cancelled 12.2 trillion won of treasury shares, a total of about 14.3 trillion won, equivalent to roughly 2.1% of its share capital being retired.
In other words, if this hundred‑trillion‑won scheme materialises as scheduled, the annual shareholder‑return amount would be several times larger than last year’s.

On the regular dividend side, SK Hynix announced on the 7th that it will pay a cash dividend of 375 won per share for the current quarter, totaling 273.3 billion won, which translates to a dividend yield of about 0.02% on common shares. The ex‑dividend date is set for the 31st of this month, and the company expects to complete the payout within a month after that date.

It is worth noting that the company also disclosed in the same announcement that it is working on an additional return‑of‑capital plan to further enhance shareholder value, with details expected to be finalized and announced in the third quarter.
This means that a plan originally expected to be revealed at year‑end has been moved forward, which is seen as a proactive signal to shareholders.
Analysts point out that SK Hynix’s confidence in offering such a massive return program stems from its near‑monopoly position in the HBM market and the highly anticipated profit outlook that follows.

Financial data platform EpicAI projects SK Hynix’s revenue this year at 345.6 trillion won and operating profit at about 266.4 trillion won, up roughly 256% and 464% respectively from last year, indicating spectacular growth.

Company executives said in last month’s Q2 earnings call that the second half of the year will see a significant increase in shipments of the sixth‑generation HBM product HBM4, along with a rise in shipments of high‑end general‑purpose DRAM, leading to overall shipment performance in the second half that should surpass the first half.
These comments provide concrete fundamental support for the market’s expectations surrounding this ultra‑large shareholder‑return program.

items.title: 伊朗：與阿曼接近達成荷姆茲海峽航運協議！但重開仍有條件
items.title_en: Iran Nears Shipping Agreement with Oman for the Strait of Hormuz, but Reopening Remains Conditional
paras: 伊朗表示，正與阿曼就一條穿越荷姆茲海峽的新海上運輸航線達成協議，雙方「非常接近」達成共識。不過，伊朗同時重申了一系列要求，要求美國先行同意，這條重要水道才會重新開放。
根據《彭博》報導，伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊週六（8 日）表示，談判人員正逐步接近就一條臨時海上運輸航線達成協議，供進出波斯灣的船隻通行。
不過，他也警告，即使達成協議，也不代表荷姆茲海峽會立即重新開放，因此能源供應所獲得的緩解空間可能相當有限。
阿拉格齊補充說：「荷姆茲海峽的開放取決於其他條件，包括美國違反《伊斯蘭馬巴德協議》（Islamabad Agreement）所造成的損失賠償。」他指的是一份如今已失效的諒解備忘錄，該協議於 6 月簽署，但因雙方對荷姆茲海峽控制權存在分歧，不到一個月便宣告破裂。
伊朗最高國家安全委員會主席、強硬派人士佐爾加德爾（Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr）表示，除了要求美國提供賠償外，伊朗還要求美國解除海上封鎖、撤出部署在伊朗周邊的軍事力量、取消對伊朗的制裁，以及無條件解凍遭凍結的伊朗資產等。
阿曼則在社群平台 X 上另行發文表示，談判正於「正面且具建設性的氛圍」中取得進展，並呼籲停止在荷姆茲海峽採取相關行動，以避免影響雙方為達成航行協議所進行的外交努力。
目前尚不清楚美國將如何回應最終協議。數月以來，美國總統川普一直表示，必須恢復荷姆茲海峽的航行自由，並威脅如果伊朗未能重新開放海峽，美國將再次對伊朗發動攻擊。
美國副總統范斯（JD Vance）則表示，過去幾天談判確實取得了一些進展，但目前仍無法確定最終結果是否會令美國滿意。
范斯週六接受《福斯新聞》訪問時表示：「我試著提醒大家，我們現在真的處於這場博弈的關鍵時刻。」
他指出，目前的關鍵問題在於，伊朗是否能夠「提供那些我們所需要的東西，讓我們感到滿意，讓我們覺得透過這次特定的接觸與談判，我們已經取得了所需要的成果」。
范斯還表示，伊朗在戰爭初期於荷姆茲海峽布設的水雷必須清除，且德黑蘭必須承諾不再向途經荷姆茲海峽的商業船隻開火。
他說：「我們現在真正要處理的是，如何建立一套航行機制，確保通過海峽的船隻能夠安全通行。」
阿拉伯聯合大公國國營通訊《WAM》報導，阿布達比國家石油公司旗下其中一艘船隻週六清晨航經荷姆茲海峽時遭到飛彈攻擊。
報導指出，這起攻擊未造成人員受傷，目前情況已獲得控制。本週稍早，這家阿聯最大石油生產商另有 3 艘船隻遭到攻擊。
這起事件凸顯，在衝突持續之際，試圖穿越荷姆茲海峽的航運業者仍面臨持續存在的風險。
美國銀行財富管理公司資深投資策略主管 Rob Haworth 表示：「重新開放荷姆茲海峽的協議仍難以達成，投資人也在這場博弈中搖擺不定。目前航運流量仍維持低檔，而要達成一項持久且穩定的協議，前景仍不明朗。」
華盛頓一再暗示，美國是荷姆茲海峽管理權談判的一部分，但伊朗對此予以否認。據一名美國官員透露，一旦阿曼與伊朗宣布達成恢復商業航運的協議，美國將撤回因封鎖行動而實施的相關限制。
本週油價在漲跌之間震盪，交易員密切關注協議達成的可能性，市場預期一旦協議落地，將為波斯灣每日數百萬桶石油供應恢復出口鋪路。布蘭特原油最終收在每桶 83 美元上方，連續第三週下跌。
自戰爭爆發以來，通過這一海上咽喉要道的航運大致陷入停滯，但仍有部分船隻在美軍協助下，透過穿梭運輸計畫運送貨物通過海峽。許多船隻在航行期間關閉船舶自動識別系統應答器，使其航程更加難以追蹤。
任何有關荷姆茲海峽的協議，都必須獲得伊朗最高領袖穆吉塔巴（Mojtaba Khamenei）的批准。伊朗官員表示，與最高領袖取得聯繫需要時間，可能導致相關協議的宣布延後。目前尚無跡象顯示穆吉塔巴是否已批准現階段的計畫。
與此同時，伊朗支持的胡塞武裝與沙烏地阿拉伯支持、獲國際承認的葉門政府軍之間的衝突，也可能進一步升高中東地區緊張局勢。
葉門週六表示，其武裝部隊在前一夜對控制該國大部分地區的胡塞武裝發動軍事行動，這是本週一連串襲擊後已知的首次報復行動。
胡塞武裝與沙烏地阿拉伯領導的聯軍自 2022 年起一直維持停火，但近幾週敵對行動再度爆發，其中包括紅海地區的衝突事件。自荷姆茲海峽關閉後，沙烏地阿拉伯大部分石油出口便改由紅海航線運輸。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Iran says it is close to reaching an agreement with Oman on a new maritime transport route through the Strait of Hormuz, with both sides "very close" to a consensus. However, Iran reiterated a series of demands, insisting that the United States must first agree before the vital waterway can be reopened.

According to Bloomberg, Iranian Foreign Minister Amir Abdollahian said on Saturday (the 8th) that negotiators are gradually nearing an agreement on a temporary maritime transport lane for vessels entering and exiting the Persian Gulf.
He warned, however, that even if an agreement is reached it does not mean the Strait of Hormuz will be reopened immediately, so the relief to energy supplies could be quite limited.

Abdollahian added: "The reopening of the Strait of Hormuz depends on other conditions, including compensation for losses caused by the United States' violation of the Islamabad Agreement." He referred to a now‑defunct memorandum of understanding signed in June that collapsed within a month over disputes about control of the strait.

Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, chairman of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council and a hard‑line figure, said that beyond demanding U.S. compensation, Iran also wants the United States to lift the maritime blockade, withdraw forces deployed around Iran, lift sanctions on Iran, and unconditionally unfreeze Iranian assets that have been frozen.

Oman posted on the social platform X that negotiations are progressing in a "positive and constructive atmosphere" and called for a halt to actions in the Strait of Hormuz that could jeopardise diplomatic efforts toward a navigation agreement.

It remains unclear how the United States will respond to a final deal. For months, former President Donald Trump has insisted that freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz must be restored and warned that if Iran does not reopen the strait, the U.S. would strike again.
U.S. Vice President JD Vance said that negotiations have indeed made some progress in recent days, but it is still uncertain whether the final outcome will satisfy the United States.
In an interview with Fox News on Saturday, Vance said, "I try to remind everyone that we are truly at a critical moment in this game."
He noted that the key issue now is whether Iran can "provide what we need to be satisfied, to feel that through this specific contact and negotiation we have achieved the results we need."
Vance also said that the naval mines Iran laid in the Strait of Hormuz at the start of the war must be cleared and Tehran must pledge not to fire on commercial vessels transiting the strait.
He added, "What we really need to work on now is how to establish a navigation mechanism that ensures ships passing through the strait can do so safely."
Abu Dhabi state news agency WAM reported that a vessel belonging to Abu Dhabi National Oil Company was hit by a missile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday morning.
The report said the attack caused no injuries and the situation is now under control. Earlier this week, three other vessels of the UAE’s largest oil producer were also attacked.
The incident highlights that, as the conflict continues, shipping operators attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz still face persistent risks.

Rob Haworth, senior investment strategy head at Bank of America Wealth Management, said, "Reaching an agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remains difficult, and investors are wavering in this game. Shipping volumes remain low, and the outlook for a durable, stable agreement is still unclear."

Washington has repeatedly hinted that the United States is part of the negotiations over control of the Strait, a claim Iran denies. A U.S. official said that once Oman and Iran announce a deal to resume commercial navigation, the United States will lift the restrictions imposed as part of the blockade.

Oil prices have been volatile this week as traders watch the prospect of a deal. Markets expect that a finalized agreement would pave the way for the resumption of daily hundreds of thousands of barrels of Persian Gulf oil exports. Brent crude closed just above $83 a barrel, marking a third consecutive week of decline.

Since the war began, shipping through this maritime choke point has largely stalled, though some vessels have been moved through a shuttle‑transport program with U.S. assistance. Many ships have turned off their Automatic Identification System transponders during voyages, making them harder to track.

Any agreement on the Strait of Hormuz must be approved by Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. Iranian officials say that contacting the Supreme Leader takes time and could delay any announcement, and there is currently no indication that Khamenei has approved the present plan.
Meanwhile, the conflict between Iran‑backed Houthi forces and the Saudi‑backed, internationally recognised Yemeni government could further heighten tensions in the Middle East.

Yemen said on Saturday that its armed forces launched a military operation the previous night against Houthi fighters who control most of the country, marking the first known retaliation after a series of attacks earlier this week.

The Houthi movement and the Saudi‑led coalition have maintained a cease‑fire since 2022, but hostile actions have flared again in recent weeks, including incidents in the Red Sea. Since the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, most of Saudi Arabia’s oil exports have been rerouted through the Red Sea corridor.
